data.name: Aqila
data.gender_notes: Aqila is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Aql' which means 'intelligence' or 'wisdom'. In Islamic tradition, Aqila is considered to be a name for a boy endowed with great intellect and understanding. The name Aqila carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aqila usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aqila is a name of great spiritual significance. It represents the inner wisdom and understanding that comes from a deep connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Aqila belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqila total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عقيلة
in_arabic.meaning: عقيلة تعني الذكية و العاقلة و الحكيمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: عقيلة اسم يدل على صفات حميدة مثل الذكاء و العقلانية و الحكمة. و هو مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ق-ل' الذي يعني العقل و الفهم. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية لتسمية الفتيات اللاتي يتميزن بالذكاء و الحكمة.

in_urdu.name: عقیلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقیلہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو ذہانت، عقلمندی اور حکمت کی صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ق-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عقل اور سمجھ۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں، یہ نام ان لڑکیوں کو دینے کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو ذہین اور عقلمند ہیں.

in_hindi.name: अक़ीला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़ीला एक ऐसा नाम है जो बुद्धिमत्ता, समझदारी और حکمت के गुणों को दर्शाता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'ع-ق-ل' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धि और समझ। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन लड़कियों को देने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो बुद्धिमान और समझदार हैं।

in_english.name: Aqila
in_english.meaning: Aqila means intelligent, wise, and discerning
in_english.long_meaning: Aqila is a name that signifies intelligence, wisdom, and discernment. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ع-ق-ل' (ʿ-q-l), which pertains to the intellect and understanding. Historically, this name has been used across Islamic cultures to denote girls who are wise, intelligent, and possess keen insight. The spiritual significance of the name Aqila relates to the cultivation of wisdom and rational thought, reflecting the Islamic value of seeking knowledge.
